description: This Swift file defines a SwiftUI View component named ContextUsageBar, which visualizes the usage of context tokens as a colored bar that adapts its appearance based on usage percentage. It includes styling logic with customizable colors, accessibility features, and layout behavior.

classes.name: ContextUsageBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a context token usage bar with dynamic coloring based on usage percentage.

methods.name: clampedFractionUsed
methods.description: Calculates the ratio of used tokens to total context tokens, clamped between 0 and 1.

methods.name: percentUsed
methods.description: Returns the usage percentage as an integer if contextTokens > 0 and usedTokens > 0, otherwise nil.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string indicating the percentage of context tokens used.

methods.name: barBody
methods.description: Builds the visual bar representing usage, with fill color and width based on usage fraction.
